# Angel One fixtures

Every file here is labelled `docs-example`: the shape and values follow the SmartAPI documentation's
example responses, reconstructed in the build environment because smartapi.angelone.in was unreachable
from it. Tokens are placeholders, not real values.

Replace each one with the sanitised real response that `smoke.yml` → `record-fixtures` uploads
(artifact `fixtures`), keeping the file name and changing the label to `recorded`. PROGRESS.md lists them.
